ui:help.en: Address of the upstream; the request paths of each protocol are appended to it (see Upstream below). A trailing /v1 is removed.
ui:help.zh: 上游地址，各协议的请求路径拼在它后面（见下方“上游配置”）；末尾的 /v1 会被去掉。

ui:help.en: Key issued by the upstream, any 8-512 printable characters; how it is sent is set under Upstream. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ui:help.zh: 上游发放的 Key，8-512 个可见字符即可，发送方式在“上游配置”里设置；加密保存，保存后不再明文显示。

ui:help.en: Optional: how the key is sent, extra headers, the path of each protocol and the request fields let through. Empty keeps the defaults of the account type.
ui:help.zh: 可选：Key 的发送方式、附加请求头、各协议的路径，以及放开哪些默认过滤的请求字段。留空即使用账号类型的默认值。
